narrative.details: You leave me alone now. Go tell Draz'Zilb we stay here. No black dragon here.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.
narrative.offerRewardText:
That lazy coward!

Mok'Morokk displayed strength when Rexxar was our leader. But soon after Rexxar's departure Mok'Morokk fell prey to temptations of power. Rather than lead, he demanded. He does not serve his people but rather expects us to serve him.

Something must be done.
